name: Cloudflare
description: Scoped Cloudflare zone, typed DNS record and explicit cache purge operations.

permissions.description: Deliberately executed nodes call only api.cloudflare.com using a scoped token; confirmed nodes change zones/DNS or purge cached resources. Custom tokenSecret names must also be authorized in the host. No automatic retries or background listeners. Event ingress requires explicit administrator profiles, saved secret references and provider/relay setup. Installation never provisions subscriptions or executes trigger code.

definitions.name: List Zones (Direct)
definitions.description: List Zones
definitions.documentation:
List Zones. GET /zones. Read-only single request. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.name: Get Zone (Direct)
definitions.description: Get Zone
definitions.documentation:
Get Zone. GET /zones/{zoneId}. Read-only single request. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.name: Delete Zone (Direct)
definitions.description: Delete Zone
definitions.documentation:
Delete Zone. DELETE /zones/{zoneId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation DELETE_ZONE. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.name: List DNS Records (Direct)
definitions.description: List DNS Records
definitions.documentation:
List DNS Records. GET /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records. Read-only single request. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.description: Create A Record
definitions.documentation:
Create A Record. POST /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation CREATE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed A request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.name: Replace A Record (Direct)
definitions.description: Replace A Record
definitions.documentation:
Replace A Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed A request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.description: Create AAAA Record
definitions.documentation:
Create AAAA Record. POST /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation CREATE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed AAAA request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.description: Replace AAAA Record
definitions.documentation:
Replace AAAA Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed AAAA request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.description: Create CNAME Record
definitions.documentation:
Create CNAME Record. POST /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation CREATE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed CNAME request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.description: Replace CNAME Record
definitions.documentation:
Replace CNAME Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed CNAME request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.description: Create TXT Record
definitions.documentation:
Create TXT Record. POST /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation CREATE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed TXT request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.description: Replace TXT Record
definitions.documentation:
Replace TXT Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed TXT request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.description: Create MX Record
definitions.documentation:
Create MX Record. POST /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation CREATE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed MX request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.description: Replace MX Record
definitions.documentation:
Replace MX Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed MX request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

Create NS Record. POST /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation CREATE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed NS request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Replace NS Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed NS request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. definitions.documentation:
Create PTR Record. POST /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation CREATE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed PTR request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.description: Replace PTR Record
definitions.documentation:
Replace PTR Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed PTR request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.documentation:
Create CAA Record. POST /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation CREATE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed CAA request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.name: Replace CAA Record (Direct)
definitions.description: Replace CAA Record
definitions.documentation:
Replace CAA Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed CAA request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.description: Create SRV Record
definitions.documentation:
Create SRV Record. POST /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation CREATE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed SRV request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.name: Replace SRV Record (Direct)
definitions.description: Replace SRV Record
definitions.documentation:
Replace SRV Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed SRV request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.description: Create SSHFP Record
definitions.documentation:
Create SSHFP Record. POST /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation CREATE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed SSHFP request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. definitions.description: Replace SSHFP Record
definitions.documentation:
Replace SSHFP Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed SSHFP request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.name: Create DS Record (Direct)
definitions.description: Create DS Record
definitions.documentation:
Create DS Record. POST /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation CREATE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed DS request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.name: Replace DS Record (Direct)
definitions.description: Replace DS Record
definitions.documentation:
Replace DS Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed DS request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.name: Create URI Record (Direct)
definitions.description: Create URI Record
definitions.documentation:
Create URI Record. POST /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation CREATE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed URI request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.description: Replace URI Record
definitions.documentation:
Replace URI Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed URI request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.description: Purge Cache tags
definitions.documentation:
Purge Cache tags. POST /zones/{zoneId}/purge_cache. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation PURGE_TAGS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Purging tags changes cache state; tags/hosts/prefixes/everything can affect many resources. Limits are conservative local bounds, plan quotas still apply. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.description: Purge Cache hosts
definitions.documentation:
Purge Cache hosts. POST /zones/{zoneId}/purge_cache. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation PURGE_HOSTS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Purging hosts changes cache state; tags/hosts/prefixes/everything can affect many resources. Limits are conservative local bounds, plan quotas still apply. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.name: Cloudflare DNS record changed Event
definitions.description: Typed event emitted by Cloudflare DNS record changed.
definitions.documentation: Event output contract for Cloudflare DNS record changed. Reads /client/v4/zones/{zoneId}/dns_records?per_page=100. First successful poll baselines the current finite snapshot. Later polls emit created/updated minimized resources; absent resources never emit deletion. Short-lived intermediate states and resources removed between polls can be missed. Each poll makes one HTTPS read, fails on continuation/full pages, caps the response at 2 MiB and the checkpoint at 110,000 bytes. Narrow scope rather than silently dropping events. Name-filter changes reset the baseline. Checkpoints commit before downstream completion. Downstream failure does not restore them. Resource reappearance after absence emits created; no exactly-once guarantee. Provider source: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/list/
